title: Introduce rotation-simulator and dry-run mode for KMS/HSM migrations (Helm + Terraform)
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR introduces a 'rotation-simulator' lightweight tool and Helm/Terraform changes to enable safe, observable dry-run rotations of TLS keys and KMS/HSM key promotions for private deployments. Motivation: customers and internal SREs need a way to validate complex cross-resource rotations (Vault sealed secrets, KMS key promotion, intermediate CA swaps) without touching live secrets or changing traffic routing. The simulator runs in a controlled namespace and exercises the same sequence of calls the installer will perform during an actual rotation: generate new keys, publish to Vault with sealed secret templates, update Helm chart hooks for canary certs, run Terraform plan/apply on a staging state, and validate identity checks. Key features: 1) rotation-simulator binary that can be run locally or in CI and supports `--dry-run`, `--inject-failure=step_name`, and `--compare-only` modes so teams can inject failures and verify rollback paths; 2) Helm chart additions include a pre-upgrade hook and a post-upgrade validation job that coordinates with the simulator using a lightweight CRD-compatible lock file; 3) Terraform module idempotency fixes and a staged-promote resource that records tombstone metadata to make rollbacks deterministic; 4) new e2e pipeline definitions that exercise the simulator against a mocked HSM endpoint and a Vault dev server inside KinD; 5) documentation and a playbook that explains verification steps, expected logs, and metrics to monitor during a dry run. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is opt-in via values.yaml toggles (rotationSimulator.enabled=false, terraform_module.kms_dry_run=true). We added feature gates so existing Private installations are unaffected unless operators enable the workflow. Security considerations: simulator never exports cleartext private key material to logs or external storage. It interacts with KMS/HSM using wrapped keys and simulates key handles when running against the mock HSM. We also added checks to require an operator-approved Linear ticket in metadata for any non-dry-run migration. Testing: unit tests for the simulator binary, a small integration harness used in CI that spins up Vault and a mock HSM, and a full e2e run that executes the dry-run path and asserts no network-facing changes were made. See docs/upgrade/rotation-dry-run-playbook.md for the operator checklist and known limitations. This PR includes implementation, tests, docs, and Terraform schema changes. See release notes below for the operator-facing summary.
commit_summary: Three logical commits: initial simulator scaffolding and CLI; Helm hook templates + values schema and chart tests; Terraform module idempotency and staged-promote resource + integration test harness. Minor followups: adjust RBAC for the validation job and tighten logs to avoid secret material.
review_conversation: Reviewer Omar: 'Great idea, this will save a lot of incident risk. Please add a quick note in the README about when to use `--inject-failure` vs `--compare-only`.' Author Maya: 'Done, expanded README examples to include a typical CI snippet and a failure injection matrix.' Reviewer Elena: 'CI flaked on the first run due to KinD resource limits; can we add retry logic to the e2e job and a smaller test profile?' Author Maya: 'Added retries and a light profile for PR runs while keeping the full profile for nightly e2e.' Reviewer Luis: 'Terraform plan output parsing seemed brittle; prefer using a dedicated `staged_promote` output instead of grepping logs.' Author Maya: 'Reworked the module to expose an explicit JSON output and updated the harness to consume it.' Final approvals: Omar and Elena approved after followups. Luis approved after the module change. All threads resolved before merge.
release_notes: Added rotation-simulator tool and safe dry-run workflow for KMS/HSM and TLS rotations. Operators can perform a non-destructive dry run that validates Helm hooks, Vault interactions, and Terraform state changes before promoting keys. Opt-in via values.rotationSimulator.enabled=false and terraform_module.kms_dry_run=true. Includes e2e harness and operator playbook.
